text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each family: 9 series, 4 blocks, and 3 durations, so 108 sums per share. The rank rule charges in each day's cheapest half-hours; the noisy price adds independent noise to the price before the dispatch. Exploratory. Dashed line: the nominal 90%. At a 40% share the rank rule is flagged in 99% of sums, yet its 90% power interval holds the truth in 25%.'
